name: @map-harness/map-layers
description: Versioned layer-presentation vocabulary: the SymbolStyle blocks (single per geometry plus the heatmap presentation), per-feature override patches, key-free imagery tile admission, layer-group names, the deterministic 12-color auto palette, the preset symbol library, and the single-symbol legend derivation. A pure library the tools, the projection fold, and the browser workbench consume — no host row.
